description: This file contains shell functions for checking and repairing ext2/3/4 filesystems using the e2fsck tool, including logic for handling different error codes and logging. It also appends filesystem types to a list of known filesystems.

methods.name: fsck_e2fsck
methods.description: Performs a filesystem check on a specified device using e2fsck, processes the result, logs output, and handles errors including rebooting on specific error codes.

methods.name: fsck_ext2
methods.description: Wrapper function to run e2fsck on ext2 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext3
methods.description: Wrapper function to run e2fsck on ext3 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext4
methods.description: Wrapper function to run e2fsck on ext4 filesystem.
